title: Disney to Hire Most of Character.AI Workforce Following Bankruptcy
excerpt: Following chatbot startup Character.AI's bankruptcy filing, Disney has agreed to hire the majority of its employees.
body_html:
Chatbot startup Character.AI filed for bankruptcy, and a majority of its workers will now be given the chance to take jobs at Disney.

This development follows recent leadership changes that saw Character.AI's former CEO, Karandeep Anand, take on the role of Disney's first chief technology officer. Additionally, the startup previously stated that Disney agreed to purchase a portion of its assets for $20 million.
